items.reason: Inclusion says "recurrent or progressive malignant primary brain tumor (WHO grade III or IV), including recurrent ependymoma". Glioblastoma and glioma are never named in conditions, title, inclusion or arm label; "high-grade glioma" appears only in the summary, which C7 does not allow. D27C and D30-R7 cover grade 4 glioma or astrocytoma, not a grade IV brain tumour of any histology. The eligible fields do not say high-grade or malignant glioma, so the residual category not_glioblastoma fits better than high_grade_glioma_unspecified. Both exclude. D31-B2 settles this: 'malignant primary brain tumour grade III or IV' without glioma in the eligibility population is not covered by D30-R7 and stays excluded.

Glioblastoma would be eligible in practice, but it is not named in any eligible field, and the grade range concerns brain tumours in general rather than glioma, so D30-R7 does not apply as written. D31-B2 settles this: 'malignant primary brain tumour grade III or IV' without glioma in the eligibility population is not covered by D30-R7 and stays excluded.

note: Excluded at S5 under D31-B2: 'malignant primary brain tumor (WHO grade III or IV)' does not mention glioma in the eligibility population, so D30-R7 does not apply. Mixed-age trial (children's and adults' strata). CSF PK of magrolimab is planned ('PK profile of magrolimab in blood and cerebrospinal fluid'), so tumour_pk_planned is yes.
